content.short: Hubz is a social platform on TON that enables token-gating and monetization for Telegram communities.
content.description: Hubz is an innovative SocialFi application built on the TON blockchain that enhances the utility of Telegram communities. It allows group owners to implement advanced on-chain connectivity, such as token-gating for exclusive access, detailed member analytics, and direct monetization through its 'AccessPass' feature. Hubz enables communities to create their own decentralized economies, rewarding active members and providing creators with a transparent and secure way to share value with their audience. It is a key tool for professional community management and SocialFi growth on TON.
content.meta: Monetize your Telegram community with Hubz on TON. Token-gating and social analytics on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
